purpose: GitHub Actions workflow 'tests': runs the test suite on Linux, macOS and Windows with Python 3.10 and 3.14 on every push and pull request.
details: Steps: check out, set up Python, install requirements.txt, run `python tests/ci.py` (which reports failures as annotations; PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 so Dutch characters print on Windows), then check that `python leeravontuur.py --versie` and `python oefeningen.py --versie` start. fail-fast is off so every combination reports. The father merges only when this is green.
